criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Matching orthographic-isometric projection and diagonal ground axes.
Comparable high oblique pitch and broad city-scale framing.
different: CANDIDATE exposes more barren perimeter terrain.
REFERENCE frames built masses more continuously to the edges.

evidence.observation: Oblique miniature city uses consistent diagonal roads and elevated building silhouettes.
Nearly matching projection and yaw, with wider exposed rocky margins around the developed core.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both contain dense housing clusters and multiple industrial compounds.
Roads and utility corridors divide the built masses in both.
different: REFERENCE development occupies nearly the full map field.
CANDIDATE concentrates development centrally and leaves large upper-right and lower-left gaps.

evidence.observation: Buildings, roads, plants, and utility structures form an almost continuous field.
Dense clusters surround the routes, but broad rocky areas remain visibly unoccupied.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both use dark blue water bounded by rough rocky banks.
Each channel follows an oblique curved course through the terrain.
different: REFERENCE water is a narrow peripheral southwest feature.
CANDIDATE has a broad central S-curve with deeper banks and prominent route crossings.

evidence.observation: A subdued narrow channel remains near the southwest edge of the frame.
A wide winding channel cuts through the developed center-left and visibly intersects corridors.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Transmission towers are roughly two low-building heights in both.
Plants and substations remain dominant over surrounding housing without breaking the miniature scale.
different: CANDIDATE's selected tall facility is more dominant relative to nearby houses.
REFERENCE substations read slightly broader and larger along the energized network.

evidence.observation: Large plants, substations, towers, and small urban blocks share a coherent relative scale.
Tower-to-plant proportions closely match, while several facility blocks appear slightly smaller in the wider terrain.
The outlined multi-story destination rises more strongly above its neighboring houses.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both combine blackened metal, charcoal concrete, rocky soil, and warm amber windows.
Fine surface texture and industrial detail remain cohesive across world and interface.
different: CANDIDATE is darker and browner with reduced midtone separation.
REFERENCE has bluer steel highlights and stronger cyan illumination.

evidence.observation: Blue-gray metal, textured ground, amber lamps, and bright electrical glow remain distinctly separated.
The same industrial material family is present with a darker ochre-charcoal grade.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both compare cyan and amber routes across repeated towers and circular nodes.
Colored conductors connect industrial areas toward a city-side destination.
Tower repetition makes both alternatives traceable across the map.
different: REFERENCE clearly separates a solid luminous energized backbone from dashed alternatives.
CANDIDATE relies mainly on thin dashed paths, with bundled amber crossings that weaken attachment clarity.

evidence.observation: A bright solid cyan backbone visibly attaches major plants, towers, and substations.
Amber and pale-cyan comparison routes remain distinct through colored towers and nodes.
Cyan and amber dashed alternatives are visible, but the central amber lines converge and overlap tightly.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use riveted black-steel top bars, left asset kits, and right comparison inspectors.
Normalized overlay proportions and cyan/amber selection hierarchy closely match.
World routes remain visible between the surrounding HUD panels.
different: CANDIDATE's inspector extends farther down and contains a large empty lower bay.
CANDIDATE uses smaller, denser text while REFERENCE gives cards and build actions more prominence.

evidence.observation: Segmented chrome status bar spans the top with large resource and pause fields.
Closely matched segmented chrome bar spans the same normalized footprint.
Right inspector contains two large bordered cards followed immediately by prominent action buttons.

criteria.label: PARITY
similar: Both use a centered bottom strip with nearly identical width, height, and riveted chrome.
Each has four adjacent cells and a cyan-highlighted active second cell.
CANDIDATE clearly distinguishes completed, active, result, and next stages.
different: CANDIDATE uses text-heavy event stages while REFERENCE uses sparse icon-and-speed controls.

evidence.observation: Four-cell playback strip is centered at the bottom with the second cell highlighted cyan.
Independent four-stage event bar occupies the same footprint and visibly shows completion, active progress, result, and next states.
